key_insight: CIDERS formulates cloud-edge LLM collaboration as a personalized bilevel optimization problem, balancing global consensus on the cloud with edge-specific adaptation through consensus-variate correction.
engineering_relevance: This provides a practical optimization framework for deploying LLMs on cloud-edge systems that need both shared knowledge and fast, domain-aware personalization.
method: Splits the model into a learnable backbone and a messenger for efficient cloud-edge coordination.
Uses an upper-level objective for edge personalization and a lower-level objective for cloud knowledge transfer.
Injects global trajectory information into each local update to reconcile personalization with consensus.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports strong gains over baselines on edge-compressed tasks, including 3.1x on mathematical reasoning, 1.7x on code generation, and a 10% relative improvement on instruction metrics.
watch_item: The approach adds optimization and coordination complexity, so stability and communication overhead may become concerns in real edge deployments.
paper_title: CIDERS: Cloud-Edge LLM Collaborative Learning via Accelerating Personalized Bilevel Optimization
